is: Two public modules: the commission and board nouns (elements) and the seams that store them (ports).
conventions: A new port area adds a file under `ports/` rather than growing `mod.rs`.
Time is injected, never read from the ambient clock.

fs.name: elements.rs
fs.role: module index for elements/: commission and workflow

fs.name: elements/
fs.role: the commission aggregate and the boards

fs.name: ports.rs
fs.role: module index for ports/, re-exports the port traits flat

fs.name: ports/
fs.role: trait seams: commission (incl. the standing reads: `standing` on the pool, `standing_for_update` locked in a unit, answering `LockedStanding`, the standing beside the commission's node; the system's viewer-less `lock_for_system`, answering `LockedNode`, and `late_owed` in a unit, and the sweep's scan `lapsed_deadlines` on the pool, the non-lapsing steps passed in; `CommissionWrites::create` takes the den's write gate's `&WriteCapability<New<CommissionId>, Creator>` and reads the id from it, and `set_lifecycle`, `set_direction_status`, `set_deadline` and `set_deadline_status` a Participant's `&WriteCapability<CommissionId, AsParticipant>` beside the checked LifecycleMove, DirectionChange, DeadlineChange or DelayedChange, each a compare-and-set answering whether exactly one row changed), changelog, workflow, file (FileStore); errors.rs (UnknownTab, UnknownSurface, ElementNotFound)

notes: Adapters: `adapter-pg` implements these private-store ports, `adapter-mem` fakes them.
Changelog entries are appended in the same unit as the domain write they record, and nothing is derived from them (59310081).

`commission_element` carries a **composite** FK `(tab_id, commission_id) → commission_tab (id, commission_id)`, so an element citing another commission's tab is unwritable; `UnknownTab` is the friendly 404 half of that rule (45514754).
View grants are per-User, never per-Account; membership confers no view (29130754, amended 2026-09-04).

Standing: every change to someone's standing on a commission (evict, leave, role change, Admin grant or revoke, transfer) locks the commission row first, so `CommissionReads::standing_for_update` holds its answer until its unit ends. Nothing deletes a Participant today. Authority reads the level of the node a commission points at (by `node_id`, never by segment); `commission.visibility` is only kept in step with it until the column goes.
